تعتكدن (form VIII)
# تَعْتَكِدْنَ (taʕtakidna) /taʕ.ta.kid.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
# تُعْتَكَدْنَ (tuʕtakadna) /tuʕ.ta.kad.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَكَدَ (iʕtakada)
